cohort_rule: registration QC pass, then bilateral cleaned-profile coverage >= 0.95
coverage_definition: sum(in_analysis_mask & column_valid) / sum(in_analysis_mask) across both hemispheres

presentation.panel_a_layout: five separate non-square figures displayed vertically
presentation.curve_summary: whole-cortex mean with between-subject SD; regional A and D means with two-sided 95% t confidence intervals
presentation.sample_size_labels: omitted from figures because the retained cohort is shared
presentation.palette: both regional selection sets use the same project blue/orange/red palette; no black, yellow, gray, or dark gray; whole-cortex curve is deep blue; all curve lines are solid
presentation.annotation_policy: short titles and region-only curve keys; repeated thickness decimals and sample-size labels omitted
presentation.panel_d: two separate adjusted-profile figures for P10/P50/P90 and minimum/median/maximum, plus concise data-driven descriptive interpretation
